versions.assumed: Two of the four fields are not stated by Ellevio and come from HLD §8's SE row. (1) The night weight: HLD §8 says windows 22:00–06:00 count 0.5×; Ellevio's own page describes the reduction but not the factor, so 0.5 is the survey's figure and would be replaced by whatever the effektavgift terms state. (2) distinct_days: Ellevio says only "genomsnittet av dina tre högsta effekttoppar under månaden" — the mean of the month's three highest peaks — while HLD §8 says per_day = max, which is one entry per day and therefore three different days. If Ellevio in fact took the three highest hours regardless of day, this becomes per_day = all with distinct_days false and the metric rises. The price 81.25 SEK/kW/month and the three-peak mean are read from the source page's worked example (6,8 kW × 81,25 kronor/kW = 553 kronor per månad).

Nothing: Ellevio states "Den 1 juni 2026 återinförde vi en prismodell baserad på säkringsstorlek" — from 2026-06-01 the effect charge is gone and the fixed fee follows the main fuse, which is D3's hard limit and not a capacity component. The Swedish effect mandate was repealed in March 2026 (HLD §8: "mandate repealed Jun 2026").
